titles.title: If You Touch It, You Can See It

description:
Jung In-woo has a unique ability: when he touches someone, he can see their sexual fantasies. One day, he starts a new job and meets his team leader, Yoo Ha-jin.

Ha-jin is extremely popular thanks to his striking looks, but his obsessive dedication to work and prickly personality make him cold and difficult - he barely speaks to anyone outside of his tasks. In-woo, too, doesn’t think highly of Ha-jin, who seems to look at him like he’s a bug.

But during a company dinner, their bodies accidentally touch, and In-woo unintentionally glimpses Ha-jin’s hidden desires. To his surprise, Ha-jin has strong degrader tendencies—and he’s gay.

Caught off guard by this side of Ha-jin, which is completely different from his cold, sharp exterior, In-woo finds himself thinking about him more and more…
